messages.text: Reminder for everyone: Member Appreciation Day is tomorrow, Friday 10/9. Branch lobby opens at 9, coffee and pastries set up by 8:45. Please wear your Brightwater polo if you've got one!
Nice. Is Compliance expected to be on the floor or can we stay upstairs? Just want to plan around the quarterly policy review.
Floor shifts are optional for back office, but we'd love an hour from everyone. Sign-up sheet is on the break room fridge, 30-minute slots from 9 to 4.
Do we know if the grill is happening for lunch? I heard rumor of burgers in the parking lot.
Yes! Grill goes from 11:30 to 1:30. Facilities is handling the tent. If it rains we move it under the drive-thru canopy.
Got it. I'll take the 10:30 slot and hand out the fraud awareness flyers while I'm at it. Keeps it useful.
Good idea Wesley. I can pair with you at 10:30 and keep the scam-spotting tips short and friendly. Nobody wants a lecture with their donut.
Love that. Just keep the flyers on the side table, not at the teller line so we don't slow anyone down.
Quick question: are we giving out the raffle prizes at a set time? I'd like to mention it at the 10:30 slot so people stick around.
Drawings at noon and 3:00. Gift baskets from local businesses plus a couple of tote bags. Entry is just a ticket at the welcome table.
Also, I'm bringing a folding table for the flyers. Anyone else need extra chairs or tables? I've got room in my car tonight.
Yes please, Chris. Two extra chairs for the welcome table would help. Drop them by the lobby side door when you get in.
Last thing from me: thank you, Rita, for pulling this together. It's a great way to say thanks to the community we serve.
Thanks Wesley! Team effort. See everyone bright and early tomorrow. Bring good energy and comfortable shoes.
